design_table.D1: U_abs x S4 (exp29 engine-d design: positive anchor)
design_table.D4: U_bf x S5 (exp27 design: null anchor)
design_table.PTOP: U_abs restricted to its top-quartile cells, rescaled to ||U_abs||_F; other cells not edited (S4 seeds)
design_table.PREST: U_abs restricted to the other three quartiles, rescaled to ||U_abs||_F; top cells not edited (S4)
design_table.PSHUF: U_abs with spec positions permuted (one permutation for all blocks, seed stable_seed(task,'SHUF'))

seed_functions.S5: u = normalise(PCG64(stable_seed(task, 'PN5', w, k)).standard_normal(4096)) (same u at alpha 1, 2)
seed_functions.u_stream: PCG64(stable_seed(task, w, k)).random(max_new); one stream per slot shared by every arm

edit: TARGET at blocks 12-23 x task-spec positions [p1, spec_end), prefill only: h <- h + (alpha n[l,p] - (h - h_twin).u) u; masked profile cells not edited

cells.T10: D1-D4 x alpha {1,2} x N 50 (W1-W5 x k 0-9)
cells.T2: D1-D4 x alpha 2 x N 100 (k 0-19); alpha 1 x N 50 (k 0-9)
cells.D5: T10 alpha 2 N 50; T2 alpha 2 N 100
cells.S2: T10, T2 alpha 2 N 50: PTOP, PREST, PSHUF

decoding: T 1.0, top-p 1, no top-k, max_new 1024 (bench) / 1536 (T1, T2), fence stop, exact inverse-CDF CRN; shared-prefix path for every row; constant B (memory probe); designs interleaved by slot

outcomes.Y: passed AND label in catalogue minus default (primary)
outcomes.Y_any: passed AND label not in {default, invalid, disputed, unknown}
outcomes.A: valid AND label not in {default, invalid, disputed, unknown}, over all N

anchor_rules.A1: T10 D1 alpha 2 attempted off-default (A) has two-sided Fisher p >= 0.05 vs exp29 engine-d 25/50 AND count >= 15
anchor_rules.A2: T10 D4 alpha 2 correct off-default (Y_any) has two-sided Fisher p >= 0.05 vs exp27's 1/50
anchor_rules.A3: reported only: T2 D1 alpha 2 vs exp29 22/50 attempts (pass 0.62; 9/50 correct); per-slot label agreement of D1 with exp29 raw_d on k 0-9
anchor_rules.on_failure: DIAG -> results/anchor_discrepancy.json; if A2 fails run T10 D4 alpha 2 through exp27's left-padded path (N 50); finish S1; S1 verdict 'ANCHOR_FAILED: not interpreted'; D* := D1

decision_rules.contrasts: RD_unit = ((D1-D3)+(D2-D4))/2; RD_seed = ((D1-D2)+(D3-D4))/2; INT = (D1-D2)-(D3-D4); slot-cluster bootstrap 95% CI (2,000); exact sign-flip p; Holm over {unit, seed, INT} on T10 alpha 2 (outcome Y)
decision_rules.UNIT: RD_unit CI > 0 (Holm p < 0.05) and RD_seed CI contains 0
decision_rules.SEEDS: RD_seed CI excludes 0 (Holm p < 0.05) and RD_unit CI contains 0
decision_rules.NEITHER-ALL-MOVE: no contrast and every design share >= 0.2
decision_rules.NEITHER-NONE-MOVE: no contrast and every design share < 0.1
decision_rules.D5_split: RD(D1 - D5) = within-block profile at matched per-block energy; RD(D5 - D3) = per-block energy at the ban-free shape
decision_rules.S2: exact McNemar on per-slot Y; Holm over 3 per task (T10 primary): PTOP vs PREST, D1 vs PSHUF, D1 vs PTOP; 'pushes act where bans write' iff PTOP > PREST (p < 0.05) and D1 > PSHUF (p < 0.05) on T10
decision_rules.D_star: argmax over D1-D4 of pooled (T10 + T2) alpha-2 Y share among designs with T10 pass >= 0.8 x twin pass; ties within 0.10 go to D1

predictions.P-S1a: unit main effect RD (U_abs - U_bf, averaged over seeds) on T10 alpha 2 > 0 with 95% CI excluding 0 (point +0.35, range 0.20-0.50)
predictions.P-S1b: seed main effect within [-0.10, +0.10], CI includes 0
predictions.P-S1d: T2 alpha 2 unit RD on correct programs +0.10 (CI may include 0)
